name: Lizbeth V. (Beth) West
tagline: Top rated Employment & Labor attorney in Sacramento, California
education: University of the Pacific McGeorge School of Law
about: Lizbeth V. (Beth) West is an attorney providing legal services covering Employment & Labor: Employer, Alternative Dispute Resolution and Employment Litigation: Defense.

Lizbeth West, who practices law in Sacramento, California, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2012 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at University of the Pacific McGeorge School of Law. She graduated in 1999. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 2000.
